title: Remediation: validate paging inputs instead of a hard int cast
description: api/crud/get.ps1:13-14 hard-casts page/pageSize with [int](...) inside the try block; a non-numeric value throws and is caught at get.ps1:100, returning HTTP 500 instead of a validated 400. Paging inputs must be parsed defensively and rejected with a 400 on failure.
spec:
1. Verify api/crud/get.ps1 parses page and pageSize with [int]::TryParse (or equivalent) rather than the hard [int](...) cast at get.ps1:13-14.
2. Verify a request with a non-numeric page or pageSize (e.g. page=abc) returns HTTP 400 with a validation message, not HTTP 500 'Internal server error'.
3. Verify page and pageSize are clamped to sane bounds (page >= 1, pageSize between 1 and a defined maximum) before computing $offset.
4. Verify the GET /api/crud happy path (omitted or valid numeric paging params) still returns HTTP 200 with correct paging.
5. Verify a Pester test in tests/*.ps1 covers both the invalid-input 400 case and the valid-input 200 case.
notes: Source: CODEBASE_ANALYSIS-2026-07-10.md | Claims: claim-fragile-int-coercion (Quality/Tech Debt [Medium], Recommendation #9) | Verified: 2026-07-10 | Not covered by existing audit-codebase-analysis-* features. | Coupling: mutates the same api/crud/get.ps1 paging block (lines 13-18) and shares tests/*.ps1 with audit-codebase-analysis-1783691797-pagination-total-count (which fixes the count-query at get.ps1:48) — distinct defects, but sequence them to avoid an edit collision. | Caveat: get.ps1 may be superseded by audit-codebase-analysis-1783691795-data-model-mismatch; sequence after the salvage-vs-rewrite decision. | Resolution (2026-07-10): extracted a pure, storage-free helper Resolve-CrudPaging (api/_lib/crud-paging.ps1) that parses page/pageSize with [int]::TryParse — blank falls back to defaults (1 / 10), non-numeric returns IsValid=$false with a validation message, and valid values are clamped (page >= 1, pageSize in [1,100]) before Offset is computed. api/crud/get.ps1 now dot-sources it and, on IsValid=$false, returns HTTP 400 with the message and short-circuits before any DB access (previously the [int] cast threw and was caught as a 500). Added 6 Pester tests in tests/pantry.Tests.ps1 (50 pass) covering the invalid->400 and valid/omitted->200 decisions plus clamping. Verified end-to-end against a self-owned short-lived Pode server on port 8434 (never touching the user's 8433) with a seeded feature/tag DB: page=abc -> 400 {"message":"page must be a whole number"}, pageSize=xyz -> 400, omitted -> 200, page=1&pageSize=2 -> 200.
